description:
## Objective

Restore generated checks for Signal values, routing, dispatch, Bus behavior, wire data, trace IDs, and diagnostics.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-03-1512-consolidated-quality-backpressure-plan.md`
Unit: `U3`
Covers: `R1, R2, R5, R9; KTD1, KTD2, KTD4, KTD8.`

Implement only this quality-import unit. Follow the plan decisions. Do not change `lib/**` or `../refs/**`. When a source assertion needs a product change, record the asset as deferred with the failing command.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: jido-07x.1 (U1) — Establish the quality source manifest and runners must be complete.
- Unblocks: jido-07x.5 (U5) — Port Action and Flow property checks must be complete; jido-07x.13 (U13) — Port core runtime and topology examples must be complete; jido-07x.16 (U16) — Port core property, system, and peer checks must be complete.

## Files

Read `../refs/jido_signal/test/property/**` at `7b825f1d050a0e0159bb2a72ba79c100b5d362d3`. Add `test/property/signal/**` and `test/property/corpus/signal/**`. Change the manifest. Do not change `lib/**`.

## Instructions

1. Port all bounded Signal property cases and reviewed corpus files.
2. Adapt support modules to current public modules.
3. Keep complete-report validation and required case IDs.
4. Mark product gaps as deferred with the exact failing command.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every property has a bounded generator or fixed corpus.
- [ ] The report gate fails when a required case has no measurement.
- [ ] Reviewed regression corpus files remain versioned.

## Verification

- `mix test.property test/property/signal` and `mix test.fuzz test/property/signal` exit with status `0`.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source manifest records, verification results, deferred assets, deviations from the plan, and remaining blockers.
title: Port Signal property and fuzz checks
